placeMarketOrder:
API REFERENCE / ORDERS
Place a market order
POST
/v1/oms/{instance}/orders
Bearer token
Write

Fills immediately at the live feed price (BUY at the ask, SELL at the bid, plus the account group's spread markup), on the account's own leverage and terms.

HEDGING instances (paper, real) open a new position per fill; the response carries position.

cancelOrder:
API REFERENCE / ORDERS
Cancel a pending order
DELETE
/v1/oms/{instance}/orders/{order_id}
Bearer token
Write

Cancels a PENDING order and its bracket children.

An A-book entry that has triggered and is awaiting the liquidity provider's answer cannot be cancelled (400).

Engine refusals are mapped to a status by the wording of the error: messages containing "not found" / "No open position" → 404; "required", "must", "exceed", "unknown symbol", "no live price", "only ", "market closed", "feed stale", "market-data feed", "LIMIT", "STOP" or "empty net position", or a refused lot size → 400; a suspended broker licence → 403 ("trading is suspended for this broker (<reason>) — you can still close positions"); a liquidity-provider (A-book) refusal or absent route → 400 (nothing was placed); an A-book close the LP has no record of → 409 (outcome unknown until the broker checks it); the per-account entry queue being full → 503 ("order capacity busy; this order was not submitted"); a cancelled/timed-out request → 408; anything else → 500.

Next: Partially close a position →
reducePosition:
API REFERENCE / POSITIONS
Partially close a position
POST
/v1/oms/{instance}/positions/{market_order_id}/reduce
Bearer token
Write

Closes qty (or quantity), or percent of the ORIGINAL entry quantity (so 50 + 50 closes it; capped at what is open), at the live price.

An A-book position held at the LP closes the slice there, linked to its opening; the answer is the LP's fill (remaining_qty, plus price_note when the LP filled less than asked) or pending while it has not answered.

Engine refusals are mapped to a status by the wording of the error: messages containing "not found" / "No open position" → 404; "required", "must", "exceed", "unknown symbol", "no live price", "only ", "market closed", "feed stale", "market-data feed", "LIMIT", "STOP" or "empty net position", or a refused lot size → 400; a suspended broker licence → 403 ("trading is suspended for this broker (<reason>) — you can still close positions"); a liquidity-provider (A-book) refusal or absent route → 400 (nothing was placed); an A-book close the LP has no record of → 409 (outcome unknown until the broker checks it); the per-account entry queue being full → 503 ("order capacity busy; this order was not submitted"); a cancelled/timed-out request → 408; anything else → 500.
